name: AllMCPs
description: Search, browse, get install configs for, and submit Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers to the AllMCPs.com directory.
author: Jackalope Digital

tools.name: search_mcp_servers
tools.description: Search the AllMCPs directory for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers by keyword or category.

category.description: Optional category name to filter by

limit.description: Max number of results to return (default: 10)

tools.name: get_mcp_install_config
tools.description: Get the exact claude_desktop_config.json setup snippet and documentation for a specific MCP server by ID.

tools.name: list_mcp_categories
tools.description: List all categories available in the AllMCPs directory along with server counts.

tools.name: get_boost_pricing
tools.description: Get pricing and features for boosting / featuring an MCP server on AllMCPs.com.

tools.name: boost_mcp_server
tools.description: Initiate a sponsorship / boost order for an MCP server by ID, returning a Stripe checkout session URL and x402 invoice.

tools.name: get_boost_status
tools.description: Check current boost status, verified badge level, and sponsorship expiration for an MCP server by ID.

tools.name: submit_mcp_server
tools.description: Programmatically submit a new MCP server repository to AllMCPs.com for indexing and review. Supports optional enrichment fields (tags, pricing, auth, license, compatible clients, maintenance status, install command) for a fully flushed-out listing — call tools/list for the exact enum values.

description.description: Short summary of what this MCP server does

category.description: Best-matching category from the AllMCPs directory (see list_mcp_categories)

email.description: Contact email for listing verification & status updates

compatibleClients.description: MCP clients confirmed to work with this server

suggestedInstallCommand.description: Command to run the server, e.g. "npx"

tools.name: verify_mcp_claim
tools.description: Verify ownership and claim an MCP server listing by checking GitHub README badge, website badge, or DNS TXT record. Works unattended if given agentToken (from confirm_mcp_agent); otherwise requires an active sign-in session.

id.description: The server ID to claim & verify (e.g. "github-mcp")

websiteUrl.description: Optional website URL for website/dns verification

agentToken.description: Bearer token from confirm_mcp_agent, for unattended verification with no sign-in. Requires the "listings:claim" scope.

tools.name: register_mcp_agent
tools.description: Start unattended-agent registration: emails a 6-digit confirmation code to the given address. Follow up with confirm_mcp_agent to get a bearer token.

email.description: Email address to register — must receive mail you can read to retrieve the confirmation code.

scopes.description: Optional — permissions to request. Defaults to the full supported set if omitted.

tools.name: confirm_mcp_agent
tools.description: Exchange the 6-digit code emailed by register_mcp_agent for a durable bearer token (90-day TTL), used as agentToken on verify_mcp_claim.

email.description: Same email address passed to register_mcp_agent.
